name: code-rain
title: CodeRain
description: Columns of glyphs streaming down, brightest at the leading edge.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
The glyphs are random decoration, never content: they are aria-hidden.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand (wire it to a visible control if it runs behind reading content).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) freezes the columns mid-fall.
